title: Sensor-activated Alarm Systems in HDB Studio Apartments for Elderly
what_it_is: Sensor-activated Alarm Systems in HDB Studio Apartments for Elderly

sections.label: Yuhua Elderly Monitoring System trial
sections.summary: A trial at Yuhua involves residents who bought the Elderly Monitoring System, which alerts next-of-kin to irregular behaviour; HDB will study its outcome, cost and business models.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For instance, a trial is ongoing at Yuhua involving residents who have purchased the Elderly Monitoring System (EMS), a smart system that automatically sends notifications and alerts to the next-of-kin of the elderly when irregular behavioural patterns are detected at home.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB will study the outcome of this trial as well as the cost and business models for installation of such system before deciding on the next steps.

sections.label: EMS take-up and subsidies
sections.summary: HDB subsidised the Yuhua trial, but not all residents, especially elderly, subscribed, partly due to personal choice and caregiving needs; HDB is working with partners to identify seniors who would benefit.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: So, would the Minister share if this phenomenon is due to it being an opt-in kind of a function or is it because residents are not educated and do not think that such a product is usable or friendly enough for use?

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Certainly, for the trial taking place at Yuhua, HDB has helped to subsidise the cost in order make the take-up for the trial more prevalent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But nevertheless, we find that not all residents, and certainly not all elderly residents, felt the need to subscribe to this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This, in part, relates to their personal choice and their own assessment of their personal mobility and caregiving needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, finding scale and getting economies of scale would be very helpful in making such a project in any estate a success.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Currently, HDB is looking at working closely with the Pioneer Generation Office, hospitals and the physiotherapists to identify seniors who would most greatly benefit from such an EMS system.

sections.label: HDB working with vendors
sections.summary: HDB is working with market vendors to put together an offering so residents and their family members can find the most optimal device.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Not only is HDB working on this, but we are also looking and working with vendors out there in the market to see what we can put together as an offering to residents and then they find, together with their family members, the most optimal device.

sections.label: Range of monitoring products
sections.summary: Other products include motion sensors that alert people if there is no movement for a few hours, and HDB is looking at the whole range of options.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Other products we have seen involve motion sensors that would monitor movements within the flat and if there is no movement for a certain period of time, a few hours or so − of course, you must teach the machine when a person is or is not at home − it would then be able to alert people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, the whole suite of options, whether it is worn, pulled, motion detected or attached to a hot pot, it is the whole range that we are looking at.
